workflow.title: Route inbound leads to sales owners
workflow.goal: Assign each new, non-spam lead that has not already been routed: companies with 500+ employees go to Raj (raj@tallyhq.com), referrals go to Sofia (sofia@tallyhq.com), and everything else goes to the shared inbox (sales@tallyhq.com). Record each assignment in lead-log.

assumptions: Referral leads are identified by a source value containing 'referral' (case ignored).
Leads with status 'spam' are never routed.
A lead is considered already routed when its email appears in lead-log, so re-runs do not duplicate assignments.
Rule order is enterprise first, then referral, then shared inbox, matching the request order.
risks: A lead whose companySize is missing is not treated as enterprise and falls through to referral or the shared inbox.
Routing is internal only; no e-mail is sent to Raj, Sofia or the shared inbox by this flow.
successCriteria: Every new, non-spam lead not yet in lead-log is appended to lead-log exactly once with an assignTo owner.
Enterprise leads (companySize >= 500) are assigned to raj@tallyhq.com before any other rule applies.
The appended row count matches the number of leads routed, and the sheet audit passes.

nodes.description: Read the lead-log rows already routed.
Keep only leads whose email is not already in lead-log.
Label each new lead with its owner: enterprise first, then referral, otherwise the shared inbox.
Shape each routed lead into a lead-log row with its assignment time.
Append the routed leads to lead-log.
Independently confirm the appended lead-log rows are in the sheet as written.
